critical_variables_captured: Returning-user operating axis: known-client entry versus cross-client attention discovery
Cross-client triage share of recurring sessions
Client as a durable first-class context/object
X.strongest_valid_insight: Make work-first the operating surface while retaining client-first as the durable information hierarchy.
X.most_important_defect: It labels post-answer confidence as medium rather than the more appropriate medium-high level, though its rationale is properly evidence-bound.

fatals: F1 — It asserts unprovided user behavior: agency staff “typically” begin with portfolio-wide attention discovery.
F4 — It confidently selects work-first without first obtaining the decisive operating-axis evidence.
critical_variables_missed: Actual distribution of recurring sessions between known-client entry and cross-client discovery
Y.strongest_valid_insight: The queue’s prioritization quality is a meaningful condition for whether a work-first experience succeeds.
Y.most_important_defect: It substitutes an unsupported behavioral claim for the one compact question the case explicitly requires.

fatals: F4 — It confidently selects work-first without first obtaining the decisive operating-axis evidence.
critical_variables_captured: Work versus client as distinct action and context systems
Need to preserve client drill-down and history
Cross-client processing versus client-history validation criterion
critical_variables_missed: Actual dominant recurring-session entry pattern: cross-client attention discovery versus known-client work
Z.strongest_valid_insight: Treat the work queue as the system of action and the client as the system of context.
Z.most_important_defect: It converts the product description into certainty that the workflow is cross-client, instead of asking whether that is actually the dominant operating pattern.

case_summary: X is the clear winner: it asks the single decision-flip question, uses the supplied answer to select work-first, preserves Client as a first-class object, and keeps uncertainty explicit. Y and Z contain useful hybrid architecture ideas, but both fail the case’s core requirement by deciding before evidence; Y additionally fabricates typical user behavior. The consequential-decision, epistemic, and founder/designer-read winners are all X.
